description: This Java source file defines a final, immutable exception class 'MessageMappingFailedException' used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It represents a specific error condition when mapping an external message fails, including various constructors and a builder class to create instances with detailed context.

classes.name: MessageMappingFailedException
classes.description: A final, immutable exception class that indicates failure to map an external message within the Ditto framework. It includes static factory methods for creation from messages and JSON, as well as a nested builder class for flexible instantiation.

classes.name: MessageMappingFailedException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-Unsafe nested static builder class for constructing instances of MessageMappingFailedException with a fluent API, allowing customization of message, description, cause, and hyperlink.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance, optionally initialized with a content type.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a string message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance by parsing a JSON object and attaching given headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified Ditto headers.
